data.rationale: The proposed steps match the true procedure in order (Careers, Openings, Country, Team, Time Type, Search, open job and apply), and country, team and time type are parameterized. The spec loses a little because it lists spurious parameters (keyword, location), leaves the final job and action as an optional step, and doesn't name the job and action as parameters.
